subject: Planner: allow elimination of aggregation functions in join operations (#61877)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. The only production change is in `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_join.go` (`LogicalJoin.BuildKeyInfo`): it expands the “join keys cover a PK/UK” check from single-column keys to composite keys by checking whether the set of equality-join columns fully contains any `PKOrUK` key, and then preserves the opposite side’s `PKOrUK` for inner/appropriate outer joins (keeping the existing outer-join null-padding safeguards). New cascades tests (`TestRuleAggElimination4Join` + `cascades_template_*`) exercise both intended agg elimination (full composite-key joins / semi-join) and intended non-elimination (missing key columns; non-injective `ABS()` on the unique-key side). I don’t see a correctness/SQL-semantics path where this change would incorrectly propagate uniqueness and cause wrong aggregation elimination.
